name: Mandovi

sink.name: Near Panaji
sink.location: North Goa district, Goa, Arabian Sea

did_you_know: Known as the Mahadayi ('great mother') in its upper Karnataka reaches and the Mandovi once it enters Goa, the river carries two identities across a single course.
Panaji, Goa's capital, and Old Goa, the former Portuguese capital, both sit on its left bank.

A long-running Mahadayi water-sharing dispute between Karnataka and Goa, adjudicated by a tribunal set up in 2010, centres on how much of the river's upper flow Karnataka can divert to its Malaprabha basin.
